frequency_question: How often do structural industry friction points and merchant coalitions successfully block or delay mandated digital payment fee implementations past their scheduled deadline?
membership_rule: Includes mandated MDR or transaction fee introductions on dominant retail payment rails by a national financial ministry where industry stakeholders actively lobby against it. Excludes purely voluntary adoption schemes.

Brazil Central Bank Pix pricing rules implementation 2023
Nigeria CBN electronic transfer levy implementation 2022
Philippines BSP QR PH merchant fee framework rollout 2023

coverage_note: 5 named cases representing major recent developing market payment fee disputes.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively capture smaller localized fee disputes across all minor jurisdictions.
skeleton: 5 named historical major contested digital payment fee rollout attempts globally under heavy merchant resistance.
multiplier: 2 hits / 5 total attempts where friction successfully blocked or delayed implementation.
validity_reason: Regulatory dynamics and merchant lobby influence frameworks evolve over multi-year technology cycles.
